title: 27 Years Later, One Piece Has Finally Put the Zoro vs. Sanji Debate to Rest
content: One Piece ‘s latest chapter finally establishes who Zoro and Sanji are as characters and what they represent as Straw Hats. Zoro and Sanji’s positions in the series and their rivalry have been among the most heated debates in the story.

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Confirms Official Name for New Avatar Form Seen in Finale
content: Avatar: Seven Havens has officially come to an end for its debut season, and the team behind the series have revealed their name for Pavi’s new Avatar State power up seen in the final episodes. Avatar: Seven Havens made its debut this October with Paramount+, and has been a massive hit with Avatar Studios thus far .

title: 'Claymore' Creator Norihiro Yagi Begins New Manga
content: Norihiro Yagi , the creator of Claymore , began serializing a new manga titled Batrlet Fairy Basslet on the Shounen Jump+ platform on Monday. Yagi serialized Claymore in Monthly Shounen Jump from June 2001 to June 2007. Following the magazine's discontinuance, the manga switched to Jump SQ.
author: MyAnimeList
